titleEn: Confirm InstaPay subscription claims, manual payment, billing refunds

en: I paid by InstaPay but nothing activated

edgeCases: Assistant must refuse and offer a handoff request with context
Mobile: admin pages are responsive; Arabic/RTL: numbers and mixed Arabic/English text must render correctly (Arabic-Indic digits normalised on input)
Suspended store is read-only (billing suspension): writes fail, assistant must explain and link Billing
gaps: Auto-confirm is built and ships OFF (INSTAPAY-AUTO-1); super_admin owns the mode, per-store switch, revert and backfill, a merchant never confirms their own payment
